hints.title: Square Root Range Bound
hints.text: A super-palindrome is a palindrome whose square root is also a palindrome, bounding square roots to ten to the ninth.

hints.title: Base Palindrome Generation
hints.text: Generate all palindromes up to 10^5 as first halves to construct base palindromes up to 10^9.

hints.title: Square Verification Filter
hints.text: Square each base palindrome. Check if the squared value falls between left and right bounds and is itself palindromic.
